body.statement: When the complier outcome support is full and closed in the population support, every coordinate projection of \(S(q)\) equals the corresponding uniformly sharp rank-similar counterfactual-average interval in Marx's Proposition 5; for \(K=2\), the path representation reduces to the two monotone common-rank paths.
body.justification: The reduction anchors the new representation to the published full-support benchmark.
body.gap: The published benchmark does not supply the finite-alphabet joint set or its path decomposition when complier support is incomplete.
body.consumer: Applied users recover the familiar Marx intervals whenever the empirical support condition is credible.
